summary: Phase 149O.20L.7O.2C -- DeploymentBinding First-Use Field Resolution Architecture. FINAL VERDICT: DEPLOYMENTBINDING FIELD CONTRACT GAP -- ARCHITECTURE REQUIRED. Read-only, architecture-only phase; reconstructed DeploymentBinding's nine-field schema from primary source (hatp_bootstrap.py, hatp_deployment_binding_admin.py) rather than prior-phase prose. Confirmed already-resolved fields: repository_id (0107866f-af7c-40b4-8317-74e71acb05ca, independently re-read live on hac-dell this session), canonical_deployment_root (/opt/pcae/runtime/src, canonicalization independently proven a no-op via live readlink -f), valid_from (producer-generated at call time, strict grammar), status ('active' fixed on create, closed two-value enum), revoked_at (None fixed on create). Traced principal_id (HATP-REQ-014/028/037: identifies an enrolled human approver, categorically distinct from the pcae Agent OS principal -- principal_id == 'pcae' proven invalid via HATP-REQ-028's two-principal topology and live filesystem evidence that pcae has only group read+execute, never write, on the Protected Root), signer_key_id (HATP-REQ-039, hatp_signing_ceremony.py's _resolve_signer precedent exists but is wired to a different record type; no enrolled SignerRecord, no hardware-credentials entry, no physical FIDO2/PIV device found on hac-dell via live gpg --card-status/lsusb), provider_profile (HATP_HARDWARE_PROVIDER_V1 is a real, closed, single-member allowlist in hatp_providers.py, but never imported or enforced by the DeploymentBinding producer), and authority_scope (no canonical vocabulary anywhere; test suite affirmatively proves arbitrary strings are accepted and preserved unchanged, by design). Proved the dedicated GitHub read-only deploy key (/root/.ssh/pcae_harness_deploy_ed25519 on hac-dell) has zero architectural relationship to signer_key_id. Confirmed HMIC imposes no field-value constraints beyond HBDC -- its added machinery (v1.4, 149O.20L.7K) is byte-integrity digest monitoring of the producer module pair only; HBDC-REQ-042's own live matching logic (deployment_binding_matches) never references any of the four fields. Found that principal_id/signer_key_id/provider_profile converge on one missing artifact -- a Principal/Signer enrollment admin surface conceptually specified by HATP-REQ-036/037 but never implemented anywhere in this repository (repo-wide search: zero enroll/register/grant functions exist) -- while authority_scope is a separate, smaller, independent gap with no conceptual precedent at all. Ran a disposable, non-authoritative preview_create_deployment_binding() simulation using the real repository_id inside a temporary sandbox, confirming zero real-path writes. Live Dell read-only evidence gathered via fresh SSH (registry.json absent, pcae has no ~/.ssh, root's deploy key confirmed git-transport-only, no hardware security key present). HBDC live state unchanged: NON_COMPLIANT, sole residual HBDC-REQ-042 / no_active_deployment_binding_matches_repository_and_root. Runtime unchanged: Observed / observe / unavailable. HMIC digest unaffected (new doc/test files are not members of the closed 30-file frozen set). Recommended next: 149O.20L.7O.2D -- HATP Principal/Signer Enrollment Contract Architecture. See docs/PHASE_149O_20L_7O_2C_DEPLOYMENTBINDING_FIRST_USE_FIELD_RESOLUTION_ARCHITECTURE.md for full detail.
